I am an old man, 58 years, and I have farmed this land my whole life without going to school. This maize plot is small, less than one hectare, and I plant beans together with the maize like my father taught me. I cannot afford much fertilizer from the shop, but I keep some cattle and goats, so I bring their manure to the field. The rains here in Iringa are good, so I do not need to irrigate, and I work the land with my hoe together with my wife and children.
